summary: iteration_88 — targeted verification of the two iteration_87 fixes plus light regression. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter88_fixes.py (19 tests, all pass, run with -n 0) asserting the new Pydantic Literal validation on POST /api/review/{id}/evidence/bulk-action — confidence in {foo,'',needs_review,not_enough_evidence,LIKELY_EVIDENCE,null,123} -> 422; status in {bar,pending,ACCEPTED,'',1} -> 422; all three valid statuses (accepted/rejected/needs_followup) -> 200 with persisted values verified via GET; omitted status defaults to 'accepted'; a 422 request mutates nothing (full before/after status snapshot compared); attendee still gets 403 on both test meetings. Re-ran the iter87 suite: 11 passed / 1 skipped / 0 failed (no regression). Frontend RBAC (HIGH FIX): attendee user@supervision.com ('Demo User') on in_review meeting c20802af-17e3-4210-b497-13d09c9e67ec Compliance tab now renders 17 evidence cards with ZERO action controls — accept-all-likely-btn=0, accept-all-possible-btn=0, per-card accept/reject/flag/edit=0, rescan-evidence-btn=0; a DOM-wide scan for any button whose data-testid matches accept|reject|flag|edit returned []. 'Mark Reviewed' is still shown (intentionally role-agnostic per spec). No regression for privileged roles: admin@supervision.com on 2f1cc088 sees 1 bulk-likely + 1 bulk-possible + 16 accept/16 reject/16 flag + Re-scan; clicking 'Accept all likely' -> toast '5 items accepted' and Accepted badges 2->7, then 'Accept all possible' -> toast '7 items accepted' and badges 7->14, still 14 after a full page reload (persisted). Re-scan dropdown (top bar) opens rescan-dialog with textarea + 'Re-scan with guidance'/'Re-scan without guidance'/'Cancel' and closes on Cancel. manager@supervision.com verified identically (bulk buttons present, 'Accept all likely' -> '5 items accepted', badges 2->7). No console errors other than the expected initial 401 before cookie/refresh handshake.

ui_bugs.issue: Pre-existing LOW from iter87, not part of this round's fix and NOT re-tested here: on a signed_off/locked meeting per-card Accept/Reject/Flag still render (isReviewMode = canReview || isLocked) while the bulk buttons are correctly hidden.

critical_code_review_comments: Both fixes are correct and minimal. MeetingReport.js:982 gates only the EvidenceSidebar canReview on role, leaving line 930's canReview role-agnostic as intended.

Suggestion: the role check `user?.role === 'manager' || user?.role === 'admin'` is duplicated in several places across the report page — extract a `canManageEvidence` memo (or a useRole hook) so future role additions (e.g. shared_reviewer) only need one edit.

NOTE: attendee user@supervision.com gets 404 on meeting 2f1cc088 (no access) — iter87's RBAC frontend repro must use c20802af-17e3-4210-b497-13d09c9e67ec. Also note POST bulk-action on a meeting the attendee cannot even read returns 403 (role check runs before the access check); harmless but slightly leaks existence — consider ordering access check first.
MeetingReport.js still ~1090 lines (>700 guideline) — unchanged from iter87.

rca_of_the_issue: n/a — verification round. Fix 1: MeetingReport.js now AND-s canReview with a manager/admin role check on the <EvidenceSidebar> prop, so EvidenceSidebar's bulk buttons and EvidenceCard's isReviewMode are false for attendees. Fix 2: BulkEvidenceActionRequest uses typing.Literal for confidence and status, so FastAPI/Pydantic rejects unknown values with 422 before the handler (and therefore before any DB write) runs.
